units.title: Yarn Numbering System
topics: 1.1. Computation of count, length and weight of yarn in both direct and indirect system.
1.2. Average count and resultant count in both direct and indirect system.

uos: 1.a. Distinguish the relation of each of the numbering systems in Textile production sector.
